shipLog.text: ◆ The wheat has reached the height specified in the manual. It did this without ambition. The manual respects that.
◆ Crop planted! ARIA considers this the true beginning of the mission! She is not wrong but she is loud about it!
Arrived at Nebula 1! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Departure Protocol: we chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Love that for us!
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ A NEBULA! The sensors are completely blind! ARIA has decided this makes everything a surprise!
Arrived at Soil Sample Paradise! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Soil Sample Paradise: we chose “Survey for water sources”. Love that for us!
Subsurface ice detected and extracted. +5 H2O, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
◆ Planetary approach! ARIA estimates the surface is 70% wonderful! She did not measure the other 30%!
Arrived at The Refueling Opportunity! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Uninvited Gardeners: we chose “Botanist counter-infestation protocol”. Love that for us!
The botanist deploys an integrated response — traps at the vents… +2 MORALE, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!

fee.detail: Administered by an administrator. The fee is the answer.
